description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) INEXORABLE (Solar Watch, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (Movement phase); P2 has 0 CP (no Fire Overwatch). The Custodian Wardens begin a normal move: unit_selected_to_move opens; a real click on Use spends 1 CP: until the end of the turn the unit ignores harmful modifiers to its Move characteristic, advance and charge rolls (e.g. GRAVIMETRIC GRENADE's -1 to charge rolls); the move is then made.

steps.comment: setup privilege: straight to the phase under test
REAL click on the stratagem's Use button
a window not under test (if any) is declined
a -1 to the charge roll is ignored, a +1 kept
the Game Log names the stratagem
